title: Staggered onramp and initiative lattice for company OKRs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create an operational pattern ("initiative lattice") and staggered onramp runbook that maps company-level OKRs to specific cross-functional initiatives, owners, release windows, and automated acceptance gates.

Why: Leadership needs a predictable, low-friction way to translate strategic OKRs into executable initiative slices across Product, Eng, Design, and GTM. Current handoffs are ad-hoc: teams over-index on feature output rather than outcome, and cross-team dependencies cause last-minute scope drops. This work reduces risk of misaligned deliveries and enables predictable Q windows for Dedicated/Private product launches and major infra changes.

Deliverables:
- Initiative lattice doc (Confluence) that shows OKR -> initiative -> owner matrix with explicit acceptance criteria and rollback windows. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKR/Initiative+Lattice+PM-945321
- Staggered onramp runbook (Google Drive PRD) describing cadence options (2-week vs 6-week onramp), gating checks (metric signals, canary %, infra readiness), and decision checklist. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleRunbookPM945321
- Rollout dashboard (Grafana) with per-initiative SLOs, progress, and risk heatmap. Reference: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/okrs/initiative-lattice
- Playbook for cross-functional escalations and communication (Slack template, on-call rotation for initiative owners).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Every company OKR has at least one mapped initiative with an assigned owner, scope slice, and measurable signal (PM + Eng + Design sign-off).
2) Runbook includes clear canary/fallback policy and a template for production guardrails (autoscale thresholds, cost budget signals).
3) Dashboard shows live data for 3 pilot initiatives and alerts on metric regressions.

Scope decisions & trade-offs:
- Start narrow: pilot with 3 initiatives (Console observability, Dedicated autoscale, Private onboarding) to validate the lattice pattern instead of rolling company-wide immediately. This favors learning speed over coverage.
- Tooling: keep canonical docs in Confluence (for enterprise search and governance) but maintain an editable Google Drive PRD for collaborative drafting. Trade-off: two sources of truth risk; mitigated by an ownership rule and weekly sync.
- Automation: initially rely on manual gating templates; automate rule-based alerts in Q3 after pilot to avoid premature engineering work.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Owners won’t keep acceptance criteria up to date. Mitigation: weekly initiative health check in the PM rhythm + dashboards with ownership reminders.
- Risk: Conflicting release windows across teams. Mitigation: staggered onramp windows and mandatory dependency transparency in the lattice doc.

Stakeholders: PM leadership (Aisha K.), Eng leadership (Liam Chen), Head of Design (Mara Singh), Platform (Diego M.), GTM (Sophie Alvarez).

Related artifacts:
